capabilities: run Claude Code CLI prompts from a keyboard-invoked modal
stream AI responses live with Markdown rendering
chat with Claude in multi-turn sessions that persist across restarts

extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin directory (manual installation instructions provided) and has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.4.0+.

summary: Modal that runs the Claude Code CLI inside Obsidian, letting Claude read, edit, and create vault notes from natural-language prompts.
